actions.name: sound_play
actions.description: Play a sound: an absolute `file` path, or inline `data_base64` + `format` (written to a temp file, deleted on completion), via pw-cat/paplay/aplay/ffplay auto-fallback; optional `volume` multiplier (0-10, 1.0=unchanged) and output `device`. Only one clip plays at a time — starting this one stops whatever was already playing (see `replaced` in the response).

file.description: Absolute path to an audio file to play. Exactly one of `file` / `data_base64` is required.

data_base64.description: Audio bytes, base64-encoded. Written to a temp file and played; deleted when playback ends. Requires `format`.

format.description: Audio format/file extension for `data_base64` (wav, mp3, ogg, flac, ...). Ignored with `file`.

volume.description: Linear volume multiplier, 1.0 = unchanged (default). Applied natively by pw-cat/paplay/ffplay; aplay ignores it.

device.description: Output device/sink name. Applied by pw-cat (--target), paplay (--device), aplay (-D); ffplay ignores it.

player.description: Backend binary spawned (pw-cat / paplay / aplay / ffplay).

replaced.description: True when an existing clip was stopped to start this one (single owner of the speakers).

actions.name: sound_stop
actions.description: Stop one playing clip by `clip_id` (from sound_play), or every currently playing clip when `clip_id` is omitted; idempotent, returns an empty `stopped` list if nothing matched.

clip_id.description: Stop this clip specifically. Omit to stop everything currently playing.

stopped.description: Ids of clips that were stopped. Empty when nothing matched (stopping is idempotent).

actions.name: sound_status
actions.description: List clips currently playing (id, source file/inline format, backend player) and how many are active.

actions.name: sound_devices
actions.description: List available audio output sinks/devices (name, description, state) and which provider was used to detect them — use to pick a `device` value for sound_play.

SOUND_PLUGIN_PLAYER.description: Pin one backend binary instead of auto-falling-through the chain.

SOUND_PLUGIN_DEVICE.description: Default output device; a per-call `device` param wins.

SOUND_PLUGIN_MAX_BYTES.description: Cap on source size in bytes — file stat or decoded inline audio (default 33554432 = 32 MiB).
